title: Blocky Villagers
description: A data pack providing a way to build villagers.
body:
![Text in the Minecraft update style: (top row, iron block) Blocky, (bottom row, green with tile lines) Villagers, (middle row, blue text on black) They're So Chunky](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6fbe552769f22ec42a9d03b985bc4964703e224e.png)
**Updated 21 June 2025. Works with 1.21.6; should work with all 1.21.x, but not guaranteed.**

If specific versions are needed, please join the Discord and ask in the data-pack-suggestions forum.
# Purpose
Villager breeders are relatively simple builds and can easily be made to be infinite. Wrangling the resultant villagers is a hassle. This makes for high frustration at negligible cost. This data pack provides a method to reduce the frustration at a less neglible cost by letting the player build their villagers.

'It's alive!' -some version of Dr Frankenstein

# Directions for Use
1. Install the data pack.
2. Place an iron block on an emerald block.
3. Place a workstation under the emerald block, and a villager will replace the iron and emerald. A special case occurs if a hopper is used instead of a workstation; a nitwit is generated instead of a general villager.

# Notes
The nitwit spawning mechanic allows this pack to work very well with my other pack, [Iron Wit](https://modrinth.com/datapack/ironwit) which causes nitwits to drop iron ingots when they're on hoppers.

# Known Issues
- Planned feature: in-game toggles to prevent abuse.
